claims.text: The resort is oceanfront on Kaanapali Beach, right beside Pu'u Keka'a (Black Rock).

findings.quote: Yes, the resort is located oceanfront on Kaanapali Beach, right beside Puu Kekaa (Black Rock).

claims.text: The resort is set on 23 acres.

findings.quote: Set on 23 beachfront acres

claims.text: The resort has six wings: Anuenue, Lahaina, Hoku, Nalu, Moana and Ohana.

findings.quote: Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa has six wings: Anuenue, Lahaina, Hoku, Nalu, Moana, and Ohana.

claims.text: Every room has a balcony, terrace or lanai.

findings.quote: Yes, every room at Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa has a balcony, terrace, or lanai.

claims.text: The Ohana Suite is the resort's family suite, with a pull-out bed and a Murphy bed to sleep up to 5 people.

findings.quote: The Ohana Suite is Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa's premier family suite, featuring either a king or double beds with both a pull-out bed and a Murphy bed to sleep up to 5 people.

claims.text: The nightly cliff dive honors Kahekili, the last chief of Maui, who leapt from Pu'u Keka'a's sacred promontory.

findings.quote: honors the last chief of Maui, Kahekili, who used to leap from Puu Kekaa’s sacred promontory

claims.text: The Spa at Black Rock uses natural products drawing on ocean plants and Polynesian essential oils.

findings.quote: natural products that draw on ocean plants and Polynesian essential oils

claims.text: Spa massages include Hawaiian Lomi Lomi and a Pu'u Keka'a Hot Stone massage.

findings.quote: Hawaiian Lomi Lomi massage, Pu‘u Keka‘a Hot Stone, and more

claims.text: Cultural activities rotate monthly and include koi fish feeding, lei making, ukulele lessons and hula dancing.

findings.quote: The experiences rotate monthly, and include offerings like koi fish feeding, lei making, ukulele lessons, hula dancing, and more.

claims.text: Guests can roast s'mores at oceanfront fire pits at sunset.

findings.quote: Roast s'mores at our oceanfront fire pits while taking in views of a picturesque Kaanapali sunset.

claims.text: At Teppan-yaki Dan, chefs prepare lobster, steak and more in front of guests.

findings.quote: At Teppan-yaki Dan, skilled chefs prepare fresh lobster, steak and more right before your eyes.

claims.text: The Kaanapali Golf Courses, with 36 holes, are steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Kaanapali Golf Courses, featuring 36 holes of compelling play and incredible coastal views, all just steps from the our hotel

claims.text: Guests can see tropical marine life, coral reefs and honu, green sea turtles, in the waters right in front of the resort.

findings.quote: can see tropical marine life, vibrant coral reefs and the beautiful honu (green sea turtle)

claims.text: A cliff dive ceremony takes place every evening at sunset, a tradition since the resort first opened.

findings.quote: Sheraton Maui’s nightly cliff dive ceremony takes place every evening at sunset, and has been a tradition at our Maui resort since first opening in 1963.

claims.text: The Moana wing sits atop Pu'u Keka'a (Black Rock); its one-bedroom oceanfront suites have a private wraparound balcony with views of the Kaanapali coastline, Black Rock's coral reef and the islands of Lanai and Molokai.

findings.quote: Atop Pu'u Keka'a (Black Rock), Moana at Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa floats above the ocean

the one-bedroom oceanfront suites feature a private wraparound balcony with stunning views of Kaanapali coastline, Black Rock’s coral reef with all its tropical marine life, and our neighboring islands, Lanai and Molokai.

claims.text: The lagoon-style pool has several large swimming areas linked by lava-rock waterways, a small waterslide and a shallow children's area.

findings.quote: Explore several large swimming areas, interconnected by lava-rock waterways, and a small waterslide, as well as a shallow children's area

claims.text: Over 80% of the rooms offer ocean views.

findings.quote: Over 80% of the rooms at Sheraton Maui Resort & Spa offer ocean views.

claims.text: The resort is spread out, so room location is worth choosing carefully.

findings.quote: Since the resort is so spread out, you’ll want to be careful about selecting a room

claims.text: The cliff dive does not take place in inclement weather.

findings.quote: Please note that the dive does not take place during inclement weather conditions.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes it is a large resort property with potential for crowds.
